nodes.label: DEC-009 Versioned migrations
nodes.rationale: Ordered, checked migration history makes database changes reproducible and auditable.

nodes.label: DEC-001 React frontend
nodes.rationale: Reusable components suit events and outfits, support rich client state and a static TypeScript-friendly build.

nodes.label: DEC-002 Supabase backend
nodes.rationale: Auth, relational data, row-level isolation, and private storage avoid operating a custom server.

nodes.label: DEC-003 GitHub Pages hosting
nodes.rationale: HTTPS static hosting fits the frontend while private wedding data stays in Supabase.

nodes.label: DEC-004 PWA readiness
nodes.rationale: Mobile installability may help during wedding week; deferring the full PWA avoids premature work.

nodes.label: DEC-005 Multi-wedding architecture
nodes.rationale: A first-class wedding boundary keeps future family weddings reusable and isolated.

nodes.label: DEC-006 Archive and audit history
nodes.rationale: Default archive prevents accidental loss, while stamps and activity answer who changed records.

nodes.label: DEC-007 Wedding ID denormalization
nodes.rationale: Wedding-scoped keys support isolated reads and simpler RLS checks.

nodes.label: DEC-008 Derived progress views
nodes.rationale: A single SQL calculation prevents stored percentages and client calculations from drifting.
